title: A memoirist of a future that has not happened yet
dek: Hand him today's news. He hands back the memory of what it turned into.
quote: "Everything above the seam was retrieved and carries a source. Everything below it was constructed. The pivot is the product: the catalyst a branch hangs on, named and dated before it fires."
cta: > Read the full recollection of the events that follow.
disclaimer: Constructed. Not a forecast, not advice.
